_comment: Tracked example harness config. Copy to harness/harness.config.json (gitignored, machine-local) and replace the placeholder paths. Keys: specs_dir/plans_dir name YOUR spec + plan directories, used by live recording sessions and not by check.py assertions; status_roots names them too BUT IS ALSO READ BY AN ASSERTION - C3 probes <root>/<slug>/status.md and <root>/<slug>.status.md for the malformed fixture's slug, so a board there turns C3 red; solution_skill/orchestrator_skill/builder_entry name the skills the scenarios drive; parse_plan imports from the installed agentflow package (`pip install -e skills/_shared`); skills_root may be relative, resolved against this file's directory; toy_project names the project profile (harness/toy-profile/) every live A/B/D launch line in run-scenario.md passes as --project, equal to that profile's name - no assertion reads it, a test keeps the three in step. See harness/README.md.
